description: edit Computed tomography of the abdomen and pelvis , performed as a contrast CT , here presented in the coronal plane with 3 mm slice thickness. It shows normal anatomy, with no injuries. The subject is a 21 year old male who had blunt trauma to the upper abdomen during motocross .
